summary: ProKidney Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus for an at-the-market program to sell up to $200,000,000 of Class A common stock through Jefferies LLC as sales agent on a best-efforts basis. Shares last traded at $1.13 on November 11, 2026 on Nasdaq under PROK. Jefferies earns up to 3.0% commission; no escrow or trust arrangement applies. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. What to watch is dilution and any overhang from an accelerated share-sale pace if the company draws heavily on the ATM.
